pageHeader.title: Console
pageHeader.description: Follow the active server's log and run RCON commands on it.

emptyState.title: No active server configured
emptyState.description: Add a server, or choose one on the Servers page, to use the console.

unavailable.remoteTitle: Server log unavailable for remote servers
unavailable.remoteDesc: Remote servers expose RCON only. Use the RCON tab for live commands.
unavailable.notConfiguredDesc: Set the server's install path or Zomboid data path on the Servers page first.
unavailable.noPermissionTitle: Server log not available to this role
unavailable.noPermissionDesc: Reading the server log requires the server.world_events permission, which this role doesn't have. Ask an administrator for access.

serverLog.hidingTooltip_one: Hiding {{count}} repetitive line — click to show all
serverLog.hidingTooltip_other: Hiding {{count}} repetitive lines — click to show all
serverLog.filterOffTooltip: Filter out repetitive messages (joins, idle ticks, etc.)
serverLog.autoScrollOnTooltip: Auto-scroll is ON — follows newest line
serverLog.autoScrollOffTooltip: Auto-scroll is OFF — click to follow newest line
serverLog.clearTooltip: Erase the server's console log file — this cannot be undone
serverLog.clearConfirmDesc: This permanently erases server-console.txt on disk, not just this display. There is no undo.
serverLog.clearNoPermission: Erasing the console log requires the server.configure permission, which this role doesn't have.
serverLog.streamUnavailable: Log stream unavailable — server may be offline
serverLog.notFoundDesc: Make sure the server is running
serverLog.noStreamOutput: No log output yet — the server hasn't written anything since this view opened.
serverLog.noOutputStreamDown: Log output unknown — the stream is down, see the error above.

rcon.notConfiguredDesc: Set this server's RCON host, port and password on the Servers page to run commands.
rcon.hostUnreachableDesc: Start the server, then check its RCON host, port and password on the Servers page.
rcon.authFailedDesc: The host answers but refused the RCON password. Check it on the Servers page.
rcon.droppedDesc: RCON disconnected while running a command. Host, port, and password were just confirmed correct -- select Recheck above once you believe it's back.
rcon.clearTooltip: Clear the visible output (does not delete history)
rcon.noCommandsDesc: Run an RCON command to see the response here.
rcon.quickTip: Fills the command box below with this command -- it doesn't run until you click Run (or press Enter).
rcon.commandTip: Commands here run immediately against the live server, with no confirmation step -- even for something that stops the server or removes a player. If you're not sure what a command does, check it before running it; most have no undo.
rcon.keyboardHint: Enter runs the command · ↑ ↓ browse history
rcon.noPermission: Your role doesn't have permission to run RCON commands.
rcon.disconnectedUseRecheck: RCON is currently unreachable -- select Recheck above before trying again.
rcon.recheckNoPermission: Rechecking the RCON connection requires the server.configure permission, which this role doesn't have.
rcon.destructiveConfirmDesc: This raw command goes straight to the live server as soon as you confirm. It can disconnect players, change who may access the server, alter its settings or shut it down, and most of these effects cannot be undone from this console.

broadcast.toggleSubtitle: Send a message to every player online.

restart15.label: Restart 15min
restart15.message: SERVER RESTART in 15 minutes - Please find a safe location!

restart5.label: Restart 5min
restart5.message: SERVER RESTART in 5 minutes - Save your progress!

restart1.label: Restart 1min
restart1.message: SERVER RESTART in 1 minute - Disconnecting soon!

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.message: Server entering MAINTENANCE MODE - Please disconnect

saveWarning.label: Save Warning
saveWarning.message: Server is saving - Brief lag expected

broadcast.placeholderAll: Write the message players should see…
broadcast.sendsVia: Sends via servermsg. Tags are cosmetic — RCON cannot route to real chat channels.

history.truncatedHint: (most recent -- older commands may not be shown)
history.emptyDesc: Commands you run will be logged here.

toasts.historyUnavailableDesc: Recent RCON command history could not be loaded.
toasts.logClearedDesc: Server console log has been cleared
toasts.downloadLogFailed: Failed to download the server log
toasts.broadcastSentAll: Your message was broadcast to all players
toasts.serverChangedSinceLoadDesc: The active server just changed. Refreshing -- try again once the console reloads, so this action targets the right server.
